fullPassage: There are estimated to be more than 160,000 farms spread across Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland combined. On all of those farms, you will find barns, and in some of those barns, you might be fortunate enough to stumble across a classic tractor like the Massey Ferguson 35. Production of the Massey Ferguson 35 in the UK and the USA stopped in 1964. If you were to strike up a conversation with a farmer who still owns one, she might well give the chassis of her Massey Ferguson 35 an affectionate tap and nostalgically remark, 'They don't make 'em like that anymore.' The fact that the tractor has survived at least fifty-eight years seems to provide evidence of its superior build quality. But wait — how long did the other 388,381 Massey Ferguson 35 tractors produced between 1956 and 1964 last before they went for scrap? Rather than build quality, it might well be the fondness that people in Ireland have for the little red tractor (Harry Ferguson, who developed it, was born in Ireland) that has led farmers there to hold on to their Massey Fergusons and take care of them as well as they have.

❌ ① (A) 때리다 - (B) 시작하다: 양쪽 의미가 반대로 배치됨
❌ ② (A) 시작하다 - (B) 때리다: (B)는 임금 인상 요구 맥락이므로 파업이 적절
✅ ③ (A) 시작하다 - (B) 파업하다: strike up=시작하다, strike for wages=파업하다 ← 정답
❌ ④ (A) 파업하다 - (B) 파업하다: (A)는 대화를 시작하는 맥락
det.tip: strike up = 대화를 시작하다 / strike(노동) = 파업하다

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the main frame or body of a vehicle, to which other parts are attached"

det.analysis:
❌ ① engine: '엔진'은 동력 장치이지 뼈대가 아님

✅ ③ chassis: '차대'는 차량의 주요 틀로 다른 부품이 부착되는 구조 ← 정답
❌ ④ antenna: '안테나'는 신호 수신 장치

questions.passage: She might well give the chassis of her Massey Ferguson 35 an affectionate tap and __________ (nostalgia) remark, 'They don't make 'em like that anymore.'
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 동사 remark를 수식하려면 부사가 필요. 명사 nostalgia를 부사 nostalgically로 변환. 'nostalgically remark'(향수에 젖어 말하다)
det.tip: 부사 + 동사: nostalgically(부사) + remark(동사). nostalgia(명사) → nostalgic(형용사) → nostalgically(부사)

questions.passage: The fact that the tractor has survived at least fifty-eight years seems to provide evidence of its superior build quality. But wait — how long did the other 388,381 Massey Ferguson 35 tractors __________ (produce) between 1956 and 1964 last before they went for scrap?
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: tractors를 후치수식하는 과거분사가 필요. 트랙터가 '생산된' 것이므로 수동 의미의 과거분사 produced. 'tractors produced between 1956 and 1964'(1956년~1964년 사이에 생산된 트랙터들)
det.tip: 과거분사 후치수식: tractors(명사) + produced(과거분사) = 생산된 트랙터들. 트랙터는 생산'되는' 것이므로 수동(과거분사)

overlay.excerptSentences: The fact that the tractor has survived at least fifty-eight years seems to provide evidence of its superior build quality. But wait — how long did the other 388,381 Massey Ferguson 35 tractors __________ (produce) between 1956 and 1964 last before they went for scrap?

questions.passage: There are estimated to be more than 160,000 farms spread across Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland combined. On all of those farms, you will find barns, and in some of those barns, you might be fortunate enough to stumble across a classic tractor like the Massey Ferguson 35. Production of the Massey Ferguson 35 in the UK and the USA stopped in 1964. If you were to strike up a conversation with a farmer who still owns one, she might well give the chassis of her Massey Ferguson 35 an affectionate tap and nostalgically remark, 'They don't make 'em like that anymore.' The fact that the tractor has survived at least fifty-eight years __________. But wait — how long did the other 388,381 Massey Ferguson 35 tractors produced between 1956 and 1964 last before they went for scrap? Rather than build quality, it might well be the fondness that people in Ireland have for the little red tractor (Harry Ferguson, who developed it, was born in Ireland) that has led farmers there to hold on to their Massey Fergusons and take care of them as well as they have.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

✅ ② seems to provide evidence of its superior build quality: 우월한 품질의 증거를 제공하는 것처럼 보인다는 원문과 일치 ← 정답
❌ ③ explains why production was stopped: 생산 중단 이유와 무관
❌ ④ shows that farmers rarely use their tractors: 농부들의 사용 빈도와 무관
det.tip: seem to provide evidence = ~의 증거를 제공하는 것 같다
